answer: Each challenge is generated only after a response seed is committed, then domain-separated with a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse. The pulse selects task data and binds verification, so a Sybil swarm cannot know the challenge early enough to precompute answers or farm it offline. Commit-reveal binds each attempt and exposes equivocation. A shale sample, grove map, or velvet token may supply task material; freshness comes from the beacon, while admission costs and rate limits remain necessary for Sybil resistance.
